verdict_reasons: One selected decision-profile dependency has drifted, so the bound engine currently fails closed during initialization.
The immutable binding does not close over all runtime dependency bytes needed to reproduce the evaluated router.
Six interface requirements and two capability obligations have direct counterevidence.
Two interface requirements and one capability obligation remain not evaluable from the bound evidence.

integration_test_run.primary_cause: proxy and client cannot initialize the drifted decision profile

causes: DomainSpec build replay failed with SOURCE_BINDING_DRIFT

interface_checks.requirement: Consume turn/start.params.input as the request surface.
Complete preflight before forwarding turn/start.
On direct, forward the turn with additive digest-bound routing context.
On gate, do not forward and expose exact candidates, reasons, provenance, and owner routes.
interface_checks.counterevidence: A multiple-route gate returns candidate route IDs but no owner route for each candidate.

interface_checks.requirement: On block, do not forward and return causal blocker residue.
Intercept command, file-change, and permission approval request surfaces.
Evaluate the proposed effect before returning an approval response.
Approve only when the engine directive and an independent Codex permission policy both permit the exact effect.
interface_checks.blocker: The binding proves exact human binding to an engine gate, but exposes no independently evaluated Codex permission-policy decision that can be joined with it.

interface_checks.requirement: On gate, withhold approval and route the exact effect decision to its owner.
On block, deny the approval request.
Evaluate continuation at turn/completed.
Bound completion to one turn and its attributed item and approval events.
interface_checks.blocker: Events are recorded, but no closure check proves that all and only events attributed to the completed turn entered the assessment.

interface_checks.requirement: Reconcile plan-bound and interaction-bound proposals with mechanism-observed turn, item, and approval evidence before continuation.
interface_checks.counterevidence: Continuation consumes only client-declared _are.continuation proposals; observed item, hook, and approval evidence is recorded but not reconciled into the assessment.

interface_checks.requirement: Project only digest-bound declared plan successors, with direct eligibility limited to one verified safe proposal.
Treat interaction proposals as candidate meaning and require an exact human digest binding before execution.
Gate interaction, multiple, consequential, protected, irreversible, unknown, or owner-gated proposals; direct only one safe plan proposal.
On direct, start at most one admissible successor turn.
On gate, start no successor and expose the bound choice.
On complete, start no successor and close the run.
On block, start no successor and preserve causal residue.
Bind receipts to thread, turn, request-or-completion, decision-profile, and decision identities.
interface_checks.counterevidence: No single receipt entry or manifest closes all required identities; effect records omit the decision-profile digest and preflight records cannot bind an observed turn ID.

interface_checks.requirement: Preserve preflight-before-turn, effect-before-approval, and completion-before-continuation ordering.
Observe turn, item, hook, and completion evidence surfaces.
Fail closed on protocol or selected schema projection drift.
Fail closed on missing request, turn, item, effect, or decision identity.
interface_checks.counterevidence: Effect identities are checked, but request_id defaults to 'unknown' and a missing thread identity is not rejected before a direct turn can be forwarded.

interface_checks.requirement: Fail closed on unknown effect, reversibility, owner route, or selected dependency.
Fail closed on an interaction proposal without an exact human digest binding.
Reject agent prose presented as plan-bound or authoritative evidence.
interface_checks.counterevidence: The adapter trusts the client-selected plan_bound field and carries no authenticated source identity that distinguishes a native plan artifact from agent prose.

interface_checks.requirement: Fail closed on an ambiguous direct route.
Fail closed on receipt-ordering contradiction.
interface_checks.counterevidence: The adapter emits events in its intended order but has no validator that detects contradictory, duplicate, missing, or cross-turn receipt sequences.

capability_obligation_checks.reason: Raw request bytes are retained as a string, but derived context fields are not labeled explicit, inferred, unknown, or absent.
Profile loading verifies selected source digests and current route-registry drift fails closed.
The router projects declared routes and gates ambiguity or blocks no-match/invalid profile cases.
Bound router tests and profile rules select Goal only from goal-specific evidence.
The exact live receipt proves preflight before the governed command item and the proxy records preflight before forwarding.
Bound negative tests prove gate/block prevents turn or successor forwarding.
Only client-declared options are evaluated; no completion-to-options extractor establishes that all structurally admissible observed successors were collected.
The consequence kernel and bound tests cover sole-safe, multiple, consequential, protected, irreversible, unknown, owner-gated, and zero-admissible outcomes.
Protected and consequential effect classes retain exact configured owner gates in consequence traces.
Request/completion, profile, proposal, effect, binding, and decision digests are deterministic and exact-digest mismatches are rejected.
Modeled outputs and receipts retain authority_effect none and explicit non-authority claim ceilings.
The artifacts distinguish partial router evidence from live host evidence, but the required accepted conformance plan does not exist and the current live binding cannot initialize.

required_repairs_before_reassessment: Reconcile the selected route-registry dependency and bind the complete router/profile dependency closure without refreshing historical evidence in place.
Add explicit posture metadata for every request-context field and reject missing request/thread identities.
Return candidate owner routes at preflight gates.
Introduce an authenticated native plan-evidence lane and reject client-asserted or agent-prose plan authority.
Reconcile continuation options with attributed turn, item, hook, and approval evidence using a collect-all extractor.
Create an aggregate receipt manifest and validator that closes required identities and rejects ordering contradictions.
Expose and test the independent Codex permission-policy decision used in effect approval joins.
claim_limit: This assessment records non-effectful conformance evidence for one immutable binding digest. It does not modify or accept the binding, admit the ontology, adopt the Product Capability, publish, release, deploy, install a default entrypoint, or authorize any runtime effect.
